title: Gideon and the Parish
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Silas Iversen, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
